title: 第四章 任务评价
slug: 网游之剑刃舞者全本免费-网游之剑刃舞者最新章节列表
content_zh:
回到村庄，林铮再次来到村长面前，这时候他身边已经没有那些想投机的玩家了，看来村长倒是清静多了。
“哦！是你啊小伙子，找到我的眼镜了吗？”村长一眼认出了林铮，这眼神那叫一个好，带什么眼镜啊！不会是胡说的吧！林铮暗自腹诽着，不然怎么打这么就也不见掉的。当然这话也就心里说说，嘴上还是客套道：“还没有，那里的乌鸦太厉害了，我想晋级之后再去接着找找！”
“哈哈！也是，那些该死的小偷是挺厉害的，你可得小心点！嗯！一会儿不见，你已经成长了不少啊！如果想再进一步的话，老夫倒是可以指点你一下！”
“触动一转任务，请选择您想要成长的方向！”提示完，林铮面前便出现了一个界面，罗列了所有射手一转的职业和职业介绍。
神箭手是纯远程输出，是所有职业中单体输出最高的职业，同时也是攻击距离最大的。火枪手输出频率比较高，攻击速度较快，是所有职业之最，毕竟就是扣个扳机的事儿。陷阱猎人就如名字，擅长设置陷阱控制敌人，杀boss那是一个给力！而斗剑士就比较特别了。其他三个职业怎么说主要还是靠远程射击，而斗剑士那是弓箭基本不用，靠的是近身格斗。林铮选择的职业就是斗剑士，要说为什么，嘛！倒也不是说有心得什么的，毕竟他也只是个新手菜鸟级别的玩家，纯粹就是图个新鲜，而且资料上说这个职业单挑群殴都很牛的！于是林铮也就没怎么想地选择了这个职业。
林铮在界面上选择了斗剑士，老村长马上开口道：“哦——！你想成为一名强大的斗剑士啊！我知道了！”
“斗剑士的武技，是射手们为了应变突如其来的近战而发展出来的战斗方式，要成为一名优秀的斗剑士，你不仅要有高超的箭术，还要有一双强而有力的腿，才能快速将近身的敌人击退。去绿树林练习吧，等你踢断了三棵树之后回来，我会给你下一步的指示！”
“接受斗剑士一转任务，任务目标——踢断绿树林的树木三棵！”
不嘞个是吧！踢断三棵树？林铮嘴角抽了抽，这要是普通人朝树干上踢去，没一会儿准骨折，也就是在游戏里才能有这么鬼扯的任务吧！算了，接都接了，赶紧去踢树吧，争取睡觉前吧一转完成！
再次来到绿树林，林铮发现这人数还是没怎么减少啊！夜猫子可真多呢。四下一看，嘿！还真有和他一样来踢树的，瞧那哥们踢的，脸都抽到一块去了，很疼的吧！要说这任务还真坑，要知道痛觉系统虽然可以调低，可是却无法消除，踢树这种高难度动作造成的痛楚那绝对不小，就是最低了吧，还是叫普通人龇牙咧嘴。有人可能会说，笨蛋，用脚底板不就没那么疼了！拜托，那就是踹不是踢了，任务系统不会承认的！
林铮选了一棵比较小的树开始任务，不过也有碗口那么粗了，想踢断还真不容易。一脚朝树干上一踢，“啪！”-60.，同时树木的血量也显示出来了，10000点血，要踢将近200下才能踢断一棵树，三颗那就是600下！林铮很是无语，这难道是在练少林谭腿吗！？估计这第一关就得让很多人放弃这个职业了吧！得！踢吧！
林铮的速度比较快，嗯，应该也说比较经得住疼吧，平均差不多两秒秒三下，就是这样还是七分钟后才完成了任务目标。看着那些还在苦着脸踢树的同志们，林铮投以同情的目光，然后自己也一瘸一拐地走回了村庄，右脚的麻痹感就算是在游戏里也不是一下子就能消除的啊！衷心鄙视设计这个任务的家伙。
“哦！你这么快就回来了啊小伙子！很好！很不错！你是我见过的所有人中最快完成这个试炼的人！”老村长一脸笑意地说到，同时林铮听到提示：
“完成一转任务第一环节，完成时间七分钟零十二秒，任务完成评价s级，获得额外道具奖励，请在包裹查收！”
林铮双眼一亮，不枉他踢那么快啊！居然有额外道具奖励！赶紧西呢？林铮正满怀期待，老村长再次开口说道：“强大的力量是每个战士必备的素质，而斗剑士不仅要具备强大的力量，还必须有快速的反应能力！去击败玉米地的大乌鸦训练你的反应能力吧！等你击败了100只大乌鸦回来我会给你下一步的指示！”
小主子，这个章节后面还有哦 ^.^，请点击下一页继续    喜欢网游之剑刃舞者请大家
content_en:
Back in the village, Lin Zheng came to the village chief again. At this time, there were no players around him who wanted to speculate. It seemed that the village chief was much quieter.
"Oh! It's you, young man, have you found my glasses?" The village chief recognized Lin Zheng at a glance. He looked so good. What glasses are you wearing? This can’t be nonsense! Lin Zheng cursed secretly, otherwise he would not have been killed no matter how hard he fought. Of course, I just said this in my heart, and said politely: "Not yet, the crows there are so powerful, I want to continue looking for them after I advance!"
"Haha! Yes, those damn thieves are quite powerful, you have to be careful! Well! See you soon, you have grown a lot! If you want to go further, I can give you some advice!"
"Touch the first-turn mission, please choose the direction you want to grow in!" After the prompt, an interface appeared in front of Lin Zheng, listing all the occupations and career introductions of the first-turn shooter.
The Archer is a pure long-range output. It has the highest single-target output among all professions, and it also has the longest attack range. Musketeers have a higher output frequency and faster attack speed, which is the fastest among all professions. After all, it is just a matter of pulling the trigger. As the name suggests, trap hunters are good at setting traps to control enemies, which is great for killing bosses! The sword fighter is a bit special. The other three professions mainly rely on long-range shooting, while the swordfighter basically does not use bows and arrows and relies on close combat. The profession Lin Zheng chose was that of a swordsman. Why? It's not that he has any experience or anything, after all, he is just a novice level player, purely trying to be fresh, and the information says that this profession is very good in single-on-one and group fights! So Lin Zheng chose this career without much thought.
Lin Zheng chose Sword Fighter on the interface, and the old village chief immediately said: "Oh——! You want to become a powerful sword fighter! I understand!"
"The martial arts of a sword fighter is a fighting method developed by archers in order to cope with sudden close combat. To become an excellent sword fighter, you must not only have superb archery skills, but also have a pair of strong legs to quickly repel enemies at close range. Go to the green forest to practice. When you come back after kicking down three trees, I will give you the next step of instructions!"
"Accept the mission of Sword Fighter. The mission goal is to kick down three trees in the green forest!"
That’s right! Kicked down three trees? The corner of Lin Zheng's mouth twitched. If an ordinary person kicked the tree trunk, it would break his bones in a short while. This is why such a ridiculous mission can only be found in games! Forget it, I’ve picked up all the answers, go kick the tree and try to finish it in one turn before going to bed!
Coming to the green forest again, Lin Zheng found that the number of people still hadn't decreased much! There are so many night owls. Look around, hey! There really was someone who kicked the tree like him. Look at that guy’s kick. His face was slapped together. It must have hurt! To say that this task is really tricky, you must know that although the pain system can be lowered, it cannot be eliminated. The pain caused by difficult movements such as kicking a tree is definitely not small. Even if it is the lowest, it will still make ordinary people grin. Some people may say, idiot, it won’t hurt so much if you use the soles of your feet! Please, it’s just a kick rather than a kick, and the mission system won’t admit it!
Lin Zheng chose a relatively small tree to start the task, but it was as thick as the mouth of a bowl, so it was not easy to kick it off. Kick the tree trunk, "Pop!" -60. At the same time, the health of the tree is also displayed. With 10,000 health points, it takes nearly 200 kicks to break a tree. Three of them means 600! Lin Zheng was speechless. Was he practicing Shaolin Tan Kung Fu? ? It is estimated that this first hurdle will make many people give up this career! have to! Kick it!
Lin Zheng's speed is faster, well, it should also be said that he can withstand pain better, the average is about the sameTwo seconds and three seconds, it took seven minutes to complete the mission. Looking at the comrades who were still kicking the tree with a sad face, Lin Zheng cast a sympathetic look, and then limped back to the village. The numbness in his right foot could not be eliminated instantly even in the game! I sincerely despise the guy who designed this mission.
"Oh! You're back so soon, young man! Very good! Very good! You are the fastest person to complete this trial among all the people I have seen!" The old village chief said with a smile on his face, and at the same time Lin Zheng heard the prompt:
"Complete the first part of the mission, the completion time is seven minutes and twelve seconds, the mission completion evaluation is S level, and you will receive additional props as a reward. Please check it in the package!"
Lin Zheng's eyes lit up, he was kicking so fast! There are actually extra props as rewards! Hurry up and go west? Lin Zheng was full of expectations when the old village chief spoke again: "Strong strength is an essential quality for every warrior, and a swordsman must not only have strong strength, but also have quick reflexes! Go defeat the crows in the cornfield to train your reflexes! I will give you the next step of instructions when you come back after defeating 100 crows!"
